verification.notes: Declassified and scholarly histories identify BLUEBIRD and ARTICHOKE as predecessors to MKULTRA. Project Monarch is described as an alleged later spin-off with no official documentary record, so it did not precede MKULTRA as claimed.

verification.notes: Official Senate records confirm abusive CIA behavioral-modification experiments, including drugs, hypnosis, unwitting subjects, and severe ethical violations. The reviewed official history does not document training serial killers as weapons or locking alternate personalities away from police. No reliable source supporting that specific allegation was found, but absence from surviving records is not direct contradictory proof.

sources.relevance: Authoritative record of documented MKULTRA activities; it does not substantiate the serial-killer weapon claim.

records.text: Owens asserted that the MKUltra program began with Project Monarch in Germany and that "we brought over" its psychoanalysts and psychologists.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Again, MKUltra program was something our military got involved with and the beginning of that being Project Monarch, which took place in Germany and we brought over all those psychoanalysts and psychologists who themselves.

verification.notes: The official Senate history directly contradicts the asserted origin. It identifies CIA Project BLUEBIRD, renamed ARTICHOKE, as the earlier major programs and dates MKULTRA itself to 1953 through 1964. It does not identify a German Project Monarch as the beginning of MKULTRA. The claim conflates documented programs with an unsupported Project Monarch narrative.
